extensions.name: Accessibility Checker
extensions.description: Audits the open document: text contrast, font sizes, alt text and reading order in designs; alt text, labels, headings, landmarks, links, focus and CSS contrast in websites. One-click fixes and a Markdown report.

extensions.name: Batch Export & Rename
extensions.description: Export layers or pages in several sizes and formats at once with a naming template, and bulk-rename layers.

extensions.name: Code Snippets & Formatter
extensions.description: Code studio: a snippet pack, Format document for HTML, CSS, JS and JSON, Sort CSS properties, Minify, and a manager for your own snippets.

extensions.name: Lorem & Data Filler
extensions.description: Fill text layers with lorem ipsum, names, emails, addresses, dates and prices, deterministic by seed; fake-data lists, tables and card grids for the Code studio.

extensions.name: Palette Pro
extensions.description: Color palettes from your selection or an image, harmonies, a WCAG contrast checker with fix suggestions, and one-click apply.
